violations.text: The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Establishment will use 3 bay sink to sanitize all food contact surfaces until dishmachine is properly adjusted. Quaternary ammonium sanitizing solution: 200 PPM at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2026
Sneeze guard between handwashing sink and food prep sink was observed in poor repair. Equipment to be in good repair and proper adjustment. New Violation. Correct By: 11/26/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quaternary ammonium sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 11/26/2026
An opening was observed by the bottom of the stairwell to the basement. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/12/2026

The following were observed with an accumulation of soil residue and debris: -kitchen hood vents -the floors under and directly surrounding equipment in kitchen -ceiling and floors in basement The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 11/26/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils can opener were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Can opener was washed, rinsed, and sanitized at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/25/2024

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Establishment is to wash, rinse, and sanitize in 3-bay sink until the dishwashing machine is able to reach the proper chlorine sanitizer concentration. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/25/2024

The cutting boards in the kitchen are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. Establishment is to resurface or replace cutting boards. New Violation. Correct By: 12/25/2024
The sink used for food preparation was observed leaking. Establishment is to fix leaking pipe at the food preparation sink. New Violation. Correct By: 12/02/2024
The freezer units in the basement were observed iced over. Establishment is to run a defrost cycle on the basement freezers. New Violation. Correct By: 12/09/2024
